2. On the last date of hearing i.e., 24th December, 2024, considering the facts of the case, the Court had directed the State to file a status report in respect of the two FIRs that were stated to be pending against the Petitioner's missing husband.
3. Today, a status report dated 9th February, 2025 has been handed over in Court which shows that two FIRs were registered against the missing person.

FIR No. 376/2020 dated 14th May, 2022, was registered at P.S. SP Badli under Sections 379/411 of IPC and FIR No. 300/2022 dated 26th April,
2022, registered at P.S. SP Badli under Section 380 of IPC.
The said status report is taken on record.
4. In FIR No. 376/2020, the matter was compounded on 18th March, 2023 This is a digitally signed order.

Considering that there are allegations being made against persons in the locality of the Petitioner,
let statements of the persons mentioned in the status report dated 24th December, 2024 be recorded by the AHTU, Outer-North District, expeditiously.
6.
Let the allegations made by the Petitioner be looked into in a diligent manner.
In the event the missing person is traced before the next date of hearing, then the State may mention the matter and produce him before the Court.

7. List for further report on 4th March, 2025.
